serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Ugh…{{wi}} It’s so cold tonight…
At this hour no one is walking around this area, it really is a creepy shithole…
Where should I go? There aren’t really any sightseeing spots in this city.
Wandering like this isn’t that bad on its own, it helps me to clear my mind and calm down, but this goallessness is killing me sometimes.
Finding a hobby might be a good idea, but I have a problem with committing to things, it all gets tiring at some point.
Oh man…{{wi}} I’m getting depressed again.
I should probably start going back soon, I’m usually not going that far from home. I don’t even know this area all that well.
